newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - May 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - May 25.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori, now on a visit to Bangladesh, on Saturday praised country's micro-credit programmes to fight poverty.
Diarrhoeal diseases broke out in cyclone affected areas, so far claiming six lives.
Bangladesh Oxygen Ltd, the lone supplier of medical gases, has threatened to stop gases to government hospitals from June 10 unless dues are cleared.
Diarrhoea attacked at least 15,000 people in the cylone-hit Chittagong and Cox's Bazar districts.
Chief Justice A T M Afzal on Friday warned that junior judges would not get promotion if they failed to dispose of satisfactory number of cases with qualitative judgement.
The national budget for 1997-98 is likely to be placed in the parliament on June 12.
Donations to the Prime Minister relief fund have been made tax-free.
Visiting Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori on Saturday sought closer trade links with South Asia. REUTER
